notes: Cuba has NO VAT (Ley 113 contains no value-added tax), so the VAT fields are null. Retail sales instead bear the Impuesto sobre las Ventas at 10% (arts. 138-139); art. 153 (read in full) excepts only industrial raw materials and exports - investment gold is not exempt. A luxury tax (art. 140) exists but its product list was not verifiable. Duty null.

sources.name: Ministerio de Justicia (minjus.gob.cu) - Ley No. 113 del Sistema Tributario, arts. 138 and 153
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: natural persons authorised to sell at retail apply a 10% sales tax on total sales; art. 153 excepts only raw materials for industrial production and exports
sources.quote: Las personas naturales autorizadas legalmente a comercializar productos de forma minorista, aplican sobre el valor total de las ventas efectuadas, el tipo impositivo del diez por ciento (10%).
